unreachable: Can't reach Eidolon. Check that it's still running in the terminal.
bad-response: Eidolon sent a reply this page couldn't read.
unauthorized: This page isn't signed in. Open the link from the terminal.
link-expired: That link has expired. Run the same command again for a fresh one.
misdirected: Eidolon answers only at localhost or 127.0.0.1. Open it at one of those.
conflict: That conflicts with what changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
unavailable: That service isn't available right now.
upstream-failed: A service Eidolon relies on failed. Try again later.
internal: Eidolon hit an internal error. The terminal has the details.
invalid-persona-id: A persona id uses lowercase letters, digits, - and _, and starts with a letter or digit.
unknown-persona: There is no persona with that id.
persona-exists: A persona with that id already exists.
call-active: A call is in progress. Hang up first.
invalid-setting: That value isn't valid for this setting.
read-only-setting: This setting can't be changed here.
invalid-path: A path must be relative and stay inside the persona's folder.
template-file: This file ships with Eidolon and can't be changed or deleted.
invalid-url: Each link must be a full http or https URL.
